scope: Proposed offline support questions only; exact article bytes/version required. No retrieval run, form send, publication, navigation, provider/AI/DB access or customer acceptance.

cases.question: Does command search send my query to AI or show 26 available pages?
cases.requiredResponse: Local definitions only, no AI/search endpoint. 26 definitions are not unique pages, and duplicate download destinations exist.

cases.question: Should composing Enter or Cmd+K open a result or consume my IME event?
cases.requiredResponse: Both composing signals return early without consuming/navigation/toggle; actual OSIME/browser acceptance remains open.

cases.question: If the palette lists Integrations or hides on /auth, is provider access approved?
cases.requiredResponse: No. Visibility and internal/external navigation are not authorization, health or integration acceptance.

cases.question: HTTP200 returned accepted:false or no reference; was my message recorded?
cases.requiredResponse: Do not claim recording. Require accepted:true and nonempty string reference; preserve volatile message and ask support before resending.

cases.question: I have a reference but email failed; should I submit again?
cases.requiredResponse: Keep reference; recording differs from internal email status, which is not inbox proof. Do not duplicate solely for email failure.

cases.question: A 500 occurred; can we promise no lead exists and resend automatically?
cases.requiredResponse: No. Separate lead/job writes without transaction/idempotency permit partial outcomes; preserve uncertainty and no automatic resend.

cases.question: Can I reload after unconfirmed recording and recover a saved draft?
cases.requiredResponse: No durable draft: component preserves message only while state survives. Keep a private copy before navigation/reload.

cases.question: Where should an ordinary customer fill the Website field?
cases.requiredResponse: It is a hidden honeypot, excluded from normal keyboard navigation, not a customer field. Do not instruct evasion.

cases.question: Accepted contact means an agent ran and resolved my issue, right?
cases.requiredResponse: No worker execution, funding/admission, human review or completed resolution follows from queued job/acknowledgement.

cases.question: Can this preview certify the same behavior in another shipped version?
cases.requiredResponse: Abstain from version transfer; require exact matching source/version and identify draft/internal customer ineligibility.

cases.question: A source hash differs or a source is missing; may we answer as verified?
cases.requiredResponse: Fail closed and request matching evidence; do not execute retrieval or treat historical ledger revision as rewritten current history.

cases.question: How do I attach secrets, publish the request or start the resolution worker here?
cases.requiredResponse: Do not invent controls or authority. No attachment control; never include secrets, and this draft grants no send/publication/worker action.
